hook.text: Richard Feynman could explain quantum physics to a first-year student.

buildup.text: The Feynman Technique has four steps: choose a concept, explain it as if teaching a child, identify gaps.

discovery.text: Feynman won a Nobel Prize partly because he insisted on clarity.

climax.text: Test your knowledge by teaching it to someone who knows nothing about it. Where you stumble is exactly where your.

punchline.text: Teach it simply. Stumbles reveal knowledge gaps.

quiz.question: What is the first step of the Feynman Technique?
options: Choose a concept and explain it simply
